title: IFC-BANK-D-PS: power-of-two physical strides and fully paid streaming address generator

claims.statement: For every N>=2, n=ceil(log2 N), and s in Z/NZ, the ONE physical IFC-BANK-D-PS program fully specified in proof.md and virtual.md, virtual2.md, virtual3.md uses EW=ceil(sqrt n)-bit physical lazy epoch words with ONE TAG PER ROW and full actual first-WRITE row clearing, ACTUAL capacities OWN=2^16 r, ROWS=2^24*2^cb, WROW=2^16 n, HQ=2^20 U (r=ceil(sqrt n), U=r2^(cb+2)), dedicated counted untagged RAW NEXT/head/virgin metadata, power-of-two VS/NS/ES/BS strides with ALL padding and literal bit-serial shift/add/streaming pointer generation, eight-word owner bindings, the exact row renumbering and indexed slot bank, and the unchanged complete IFC-LIMIT-D reference program P. It outputs the ENTIRE secret with unconditional probability at least 1-2^-8>2/3 under independent ideal coset inputs. On EVERY branch, including all failed/aborted/recycled trials, initialization, metadata, source swaps, address/circuit generation and final disposal, jointly with the other resource and tolerance claims, total charged sequential time is O(n^10 2^((1521/1000)sqrt n)); Sections 9-10 derive n^4 C_P with C_P=O(n^6 2^((1521/1000)sqrt n)), using the counted O(sqrt n) global address fee, separately charged acquisition instructions and amortized repeated exact renumbering. The declared envelope has growth index 1/2.

Exactly one acquisition is made per logical P request; bookkeeping adds none. Its envelope has growth index 1/2.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
